en.headline: Firefighters put out Mong Kok flat fire linked to charger, several people treated
en.dek: Firefighters extinguished a Mong Kok flat fire linked to a charger within half an hour, with more than twenty residents evacuated and several people feeling unwell from smoke.
body: Firefighters responded to reports of smoke from a flat at 316-320 Reclamation Street in Mong Kok's Wing Fuk Building at about 7:10am on Wednesday.

Crews deployed a hose and a breathing apparatus team to tackle the fire, which was brought under control by 7:39am. Initial reports indicated a charger may have short-circuited and caused the smoke. About twenty-five residents, including men and women, left the building on their own.

At least three people, including an infant, reported feeling unwell from smoke. One man in his twenties was taken to Kwong Wah Hospital for treatment after inhaling smoke. Streets nearby were temporarily closed during the operation. The cause is under investigation.

zh.headline: 旺角新填地街單位疑充電器起火 消防灌救多人疏散
zh.dek: 旺角永福大廈一住宅單位今早七時許疑充電器短路冒煙起火，消防半小時內將火救熄，約二十五人自行疏散，數人包括嬰兒感到不適。
body: 消防處表示，周三早上約七時十分，接報旺角新填地街316至320號永福大廈有單位冒煙起火。
消防員出動喉管及煙帽隊到場灌救，至約七時三十九分將火救熄。初步消息指疑有充電器短路引致冒煙。期間約二十五名居民自行疏散離開大廈。
事件中至少三人感到不適，包括一名男嬰。其中一名二十多歲男子吸入濃煙後被送往廣華醫院治理。附近街道一度封閉，火警原因有待調查。
